scenario: A user attempts to log into the administrative portal. The system uses single sign-on (SSO) and requires multi-factor authentication (MFA) via SMS. The user provides a valid username and password, but the SMS delivery service is currently experiencing a regional outage. The authentication service falls back to sending an email link, but policy requires this link to be clicked from a separate pre-registered device. The user clicks it from the same device.
context: The application relies on Auth0 for identity management. Fallback mechanisms are enabled for all users by default.
evidence: Log line: 'Failed to deliver SMS to +1***5555: Gateway Timeout'
Log line: 'Fallback initiated: Email link sent to user@example.com'
Log line: 'Email link verified successfully from IP 192.168.1.50'

one_fact_flip.changed_fact: No separate device was used despite policy
